submitted.rationale: Of the three measurements, index 111 (Bi 0.08, Cu 0.50, V 0.42) gave the highest photocurrent, 1.83e-6 A. This composition is close to a 1:1 Cu:V ratio (the Cu2V2O7 copper vanadate), with little Bi.

rejected.reason: Bi-V-rich composition near BiVO4 with about 20% Cu measured 9e-7 A, about half of index 111.
More Cu-rich copper vanadate (close to Cu3V2O8) measured 7.1e-7 A, lower than the 1:1 Cu:V composition.
